boundaries: Dense change can favor FULL substantially; a tested 50% change package was about 3.46 times the expanded representation.
One latest full snapshot is smaller when only current state is required.
Competent incremental history was 7.88 to 16.94 percent smaller than Helix in the measured campaigns.
After competent CDC dedupe plus Zstd, Helix residual savings were 5.65 to 6.40 percent, below the predeclared 20 percent materiality threshold.
The approximately 0.1 percent sparse-change result remained exact from about 44K through 1M rows; it is not an extrapolation beyond that range.
